title: Celadon City, Rocket Hideout & Pokémon Tower
subtitle: Eevee, Tea, Rainbow Badge, Giovanni, Silph Scope, Poké Flute

steps.text: Celadon Mansion (northwest): the old woman on 1F gives Tea. Give it to any Saffron gate guard to open Saffron City.
Celadon Mansion back door (enter from behind the building), climb to the roof room: a free Eevee Lv.25. Evolve with Fire/Water/Thunder Stone from the Department Store 4F.
Softboiled Move Tutor in Celadon (near the Pokémon Center pond). Only Chansey, Blissey and Mew can learn it.

Department Store: 2F medicine and TMs (Dig 28, Brick Break 31, Roar, Hyper Beam 15, Secret Power, Attract), 3F Counter tutor, 4F evolution stones and Poké Doll, 5F vitamins and X items. Buy a Poké Doll for the Copycat later.
Rooftop vending machines: buy a Fresh Water, Soda Pop and Lemonade and give one of each to the little girl for TM16 Light Screen, TM20 Safeguard and TM33 Reflect.
Department Store 3F: Counter Move Tutor (once).
Restaurant (south side): the man inside gives the Coin Case. Game Corner slots and hidden coins on the floor fill it.

Erika: Victreebel Lv.29, Tangela Lv.24, Vileplume Lv.29. Fire or Flying types; Charmeleon's Ember/Flamethrower, Pidgeotto's Wing Attack. Watch for Sleep Powder and Poison. Cut the trees to enter the gym.
Gym Leader Erika. Rainbow Badge (Strength usable, obedience to Lv.50) and TM19 Giga Drain.
Game Corner: beat the Rocket Grunt guarding the poster in the back, then press A on the poster to open the stairs to the Rocket Hideout.

Game Corner prizes (Prize Corner next door): Abra 180c, Clefairy 500c, Scyther 5,500c, Dratini 2,800c, Porygon 9,999c; TM13 Ice Beam 4,000c, TM23 Iron Tail 3,500c, TM24 Thunderbolt 4,000c, TM30 Shadow Ball 4,500c, TM35 Flamethrower 4,000c. Coins cost $50 each, or buy and pick up the hidden coins on the floor.
Rocket Hideout B1F: grunts and items; stairs down in the northwest and southeast.
B2F: spinner-tile maze. Take the spinners to reach the items and the far stairs.
B4F: beat the Grunt in the northwest and talk to him again — he drops the Lift Key. Use the elevator to reach Giovanni's office.
Team Rocket Boss Giovanni. Onix Lv.25, Rhyhorn Lv.24, Kangaskhan Lv.29. Water/Grass for the Rock types; Kangaskhan hits hard, bring a Fighting move or just outlast it.
Giovanni leaves the Silph Scope behind. Grab it and the remaining items.
Fly/walk back to Lavender Town and enter Pokémon Tower with the Silph Scope.
Rival battle 5 on Pokémon Tower 2F. Pidgeotto Lv.25, Gyarados/Growlithe/Exeggcute Lv.22-23, Kadabra Lv.20, starter Lv.25.
Floors 3-7: possessed Channelers (Gastly/Haunter; catch a Gastly here). Gastly and Cubone in the wild. The healing tile on 5F fully restores your party.
6F: the ghost Marowak (Lv.30) attacks. It cannot be caught; just defeat it.
7F: three Rocket Grunts guard Mr. Fuji. Beat them and talk to him; he takes you to his house.
Mr. Fuji gives you the Poké Flute. It wakes the two Snorlax (Routes 12 and 16) and cures sleep in battle.
